digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler peer-confirmation storage and dispatch integration
propositions: A new PeerConfirmationStore module must persist peer-confirmation records keyed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) with fields for link_id, direction, confirmed_pass, confirmed_at, and source_kind.

Outbound link ADDs must record a peer confirmation via a link_confirm callback invoked after successful set_relationship, capturing the returned link_id and translating Jira keys to local ids via binding_store.get_local_id.
Unbound targets (when binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must skip recording entirely without raising or failing the outbound link.
The peer_confirmations.json file must be staged for commit in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames so confirmation-only changes are not silently dropped by the idempotency guard.
A failing link_confirm callback must be logged and swallowed so that confirmation failures never propagate or alter link applied/computed/failed counts.
